name: Gloves
description: Brokered secret access for OpenClaw agents via host-side gloves-mcp sessions.

root.description: Host path to the gloves runtime root.

mcpConfigPath.description: Host path to the gloves-mcp TOML config file.

tokenPath.description: Host path where gloves-mcp writes the session token.

glovesMcpBin.description: Optional absolute host path to the gloves-mcp binary when it is not already on the Gateway PATH.

glovesBin.description: Optional gloves CLI path retained for compatibility.

socketPath.description: Optional legacy Unix socket path. Omit to use the recommended stdio launch path.

cwd.description: Optional working directory for spawned gloves-mcp sessions.

injectMode.description: How decrypted values are injected into the sandbox.
